checks.name: Standard ML list fold
checks.code:
val values = List.tabulate(10, fn i => i+1);
val () = print(Int.toString(List.foldl (op +) 0 values) ^ "\n");

Standard ML structure and function
checks.code:
structure Museum = struct val n=6 fun twice x=x*2 end;
val () = print(Int.toString(Museum.twice Museum.n) ^ "\n");

checks.name: Standard ML multiline UTF-8 stdin

fun line () = case TextIO.inputLine TextIO.stdIn of SOME s => print("[" ^ String.substring(s,0,String.size s-1) ^ "]\n") | NONE => ();
val () = (line(); line());
